changes: p1: added a note that 'vaṃdyo' may be a surname (Vandya / Bandyopādhyāya) rather than the epithet 'venerable'. The name itself is unchanged.
p2: confidence lowered to medium; 'padmādāsamude' is a compound and the name boundary is not certain (it could be Padmādāsa or a feminine Padmā-based name).
date: month glossed as śuci = Āṣāḍha; tithi given as navamī (Durgā); weekday normalised to Tuesday; paksa left uncertain.
purpose: rewritten in plain English instead of the bare compound.

date.as_written: giryantarikṣāṃkasomair mite vikramavatsare || śuci māse tīladale durgāyāṃ bhaumavāsare
date.paksa: tīladala (unclear; corrupt for sita- or asitadala?)

notes: Chronogram read right to left: giri 7, antarikṣa 0, aṅka 9, soma 1 = VS 1907 (about 1850 CE), which matches the catalogue. Śuci usually means Āṣāḍha. 'tīladale' is probably corrupt; the paksa (bright or dark half) cannot be settled. Durgā is taken as navamī (the 9th tithi); aṣṭamī is less likely. 'vaṃdyo' can be read as 'venerable', describing the scribe, or as the Bengali surname Vandya/Bandyopādhyāya; if it is a surname, it belongs among Viśvaharṣa's titles. The name Padmādāsa is cut out of the compound 'padmādāsamude' and is not certain.
